SELECT , c.created_at AS created_at_view FROM tb_bbs_comment c WHERE c.comment_id = #{commentId} AND c.delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_bbs_comment ( comment_id, article_id, parent_comment_id, writer_user_id, writer_user_type, writer_name, writer_password, content, secret_yn, depth, client_ip, status, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{commentId}, #{articleId}, #{parentCommentId}, #{writerUserId}, #{writerUserType}, #{writerName}, #{writerPassword}, #{content}, #{secretYn}, #{depth}, #{clientIp}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_bbs_comment SET content = #{content}, secret_yn = #{secretYn}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
UPDATE tb_bbs_comment SET status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
UPDATE tb_bbs_comment SET delete_yn = 'Y', status = 'DELETED', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}

UPDATE tb_bbs_comment SET delete_yn = 'Y', status = 'DELETED', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE parent_comment_id = #{parentCommentId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
